findings.title: Array display truncation corrupts the GGUF parse cursor
findings.evidence: The ARRAY branch consumes count.min(10) values then returns that cursor, without skipping remaining elements.
findings.trigger: Load a valid GGUF metadata array containing more than ten elements, such as tokenizer vocabulary.
findings.impact: The next metadata key or tensor descriptor is read from inside the array; ordinary models fail to load or receive incorrect descriptors.

findings.title: Truncated GGUF metadata panics instead of returning an error
findings.evidence: parse_metadata_value directly indexes mmap[cursor] and slices cursor..cursor+N; caller checks the type tag but not its payload.
findings.trigger: A file ends immediately after a UINT8 metadata type tag, or contains a truncated string/scalar payload.
findings.impact: Untrusted model input can panic the inference process rather than produce load_mmap Err.

findings.title: Consolidation discards divergent same-name master ledgers
findings.evidence: _process_master_db returns True when destination already exists (lines 33-35); caller then unconditionally calls _purge_db_file.
findings.trigger: A master ledger exists in ~/.babylon60/dbs and the repository contains a different ledger with the same basename.
findings.impact: Source ledger and sidecars are deleted without comparing, merging, or preserving its records.

findings.title: Copying only SQLite main file loses WAL commits
findings.evidence: shutil.copy2 copies only db_path; _purge_db_file unlinks its -wal and -shm at lines 41-42.
findings.trigger: Consolidate a WAL-mode master ledger with committed pages still in its WAL.
findings.impact: Central copy omits committed transactions, then the source WAL carrying them is removed.

findings.title: Concurrent rate limiter callers reserve the same future slot
findings.evidence: _refill resets _last_refill=now even when it was a future reservation; every deficit caller then sets tokens=0 and last_refill=clock()+wait_s.
findings.trigger: Several threads acquire while the bucket is empty before the first waiting caller wakes.
findings.impact: They all receive approximately the same wait and dispatch together, violating the intended rate bound and increasing upstream throttling.

findings.title: Sensitive routing omits the explicit target from its free-model veto
findings.evidence: candidate_list uses payload.models whenever present; build_chat_payload chooses explicit model as payload.model independently (lines 649-650); sensitive context does not imply enforce_floor at line 732.
findings.trigger: query receives sensitive context_paths, an explicit :free model, and a paid-only models list.
findings.impact: The pre-dispatch sensitive guard approves a payload retaining the free target. Postflight rejection happens after the prompt has already been transmitted; this defeats the local confidentiality check regardless of gateway routing outcome.

findings.title: Receipt interpolation fails to escape JSON control characters
findings.evidence: prompt/action/scope/agent only replace double quotes before interpolation into jsonResponse; backslashes and newlines are not JSON encoded.
findings.trigger: An authorized invocation includes a multiline prompt or a path containing backslashes.
findings.impact: Successful biometric signing emits malformed or altered JSON fields, causing receipt consumers to reject or misinterpret the result.

findings.title: Generator computes scripts directory as its output root
findings.evidence: dirname(dirname(__file__)) from scripts/c5_isomorphisms resolves to scripts; output paths append cortex, babylon60 and docs.
findings.trigger: Run this generator from its current repository location.
findings.impact: It writes scripts/cortex, scripts/babylon60 and scripts/docs instead of updating canonical repository outputs.

findings.title: History sanitizer certifies all history after sampling only 100 commits
findings.evidence: Content scanning uses git log -n 100 without --all, while line 110 certifies all commits in history.
findings.trigger: A secret in a normal source filename exists only in an older commit or another branch outside the sampled log.
findings.impact: audit_git_history can return clean and the CLI certifies zero leakage despite unscanned reachable content; filename and size checks do not detect those secrets.
